title: Keeping a connection when it matters most.
summary: Building redundant communications for mobile workstations between Switzerland and the children’s hospital in Bethlehem.
context: Mobile workstations needed to communicate between Switzerland and the children’s hospital in Bethlehem with high resilience. Redundant communication paths were built, with fallback options extending to an analogue modem.
work: Building communications designed for high resilience
Connecting mobile workstations between Switzerland and the children’s hospital
Redundant communication paths with fallback options extending to an analogue modem
technologies: Analogue modem connection as a fallback
motivation: A small project with lasting personal significance: this experience became a long-term motivation for Here to Help. It showed how focused technical support can make a meaningful contribution to a human cause.
